term: irreflexivity of the selected simple-priority relation
definition: Standard Lean/Mathlib Std.Irrefl PriorSimply on the SAME candidate carrier and simple-priority argument used by act-priority and firstness: ∀ x, ¬ PriorSimply x x. No new relation is introduced. Strict here means only no self-priority, not a strict total order.
note: OPEN framework assumption, no historical attribution or independent defense. Ordinary dependency-order examples motivate considering no self-priority but do not justify metaphysical scope; feedback and mixed act/bearer relations are not silently excluded or identified. Existing simple-priority meaning and priority-to-actual-ground correspondence remain unchanged and open. Controls compare formal assignments only; they do not establish that coexistence of act/potency or self-priority is philosophically admissible.
